definitions.explanation: Expressing high approval or admiration for someone's actions, achievements, or character.

examples.japanese: {称賛|しょうさん}の{声|こえ}が{上|あ}がった。
{彼女|かのじょ}の{勇気|ゆうき}ある{行動|こうどう}は{称賛|しょうさん}に{値|あたい}する。
{世界中|せかいじゅう}から{称賛|しょうさん}を{浴|あ}びた{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}が{講演|こうえん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: The researcher who received praise from around the world gave a lecture.

notes:
A formal word for praise or commendation. Composed of {称|しょう} (to praise, to name) + {賛|さん} (to approve, to praise). Used in formal writing, news, and official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {称賛|しょうさん}する: to praise, to commend
- {称賛|しょうさん}を{浴|あ}びる: to receive praise
- {称賛|しょうさん}に{値|あたい}する: to be worthy of praise
- {称賛|しょうさん}の{声|こえ}: voices of praise
- {称賛|しょうさん}を{送|おく}る: to give praise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {賞賛|しょうさん}: praise — variant kanji form with the same reading and meaning; both are standard
- {褒|ほ}める: to praise — everyday verb; much more colloquial
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}: extremely high praise — stronger intensity
- {賛辞|さんじ}: words of praise, tribute — more literary

NOTE ON KANJI VARIANTS:
{称賛|しょうさん} and {賞賛|しょうさん} are interchangeable in most contexts. {称賛|しょうさん} is slightly more common in modern usage.
